question: What will be the closing value of the S&P 500 index (^GSPC on Yahoo Finance) on October 5, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of ^GSPC on Yahoo Finance for 2026-10-05. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.

research:
I'm writing up the findings now. Several search results described events after 2026-09-07, so I left them out, and every direct page fetch was refused by the proxy.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-09-04: The latest ^GSPC close on Yahoo Finance, collected by code, is **7,718.60**. October 5, 2026 is a Monday and a regular trading day, so that day's close will decide the question.
- I could not open Yahoo pages directly because the proxy refused the connection.
- 2026-09-04: A Kalshi contract on the S&P price at 4pm EDT that day had resolved. I could not see which threshold resolved; the listed thresholds start around 7,640. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxinxu/sp-500-abovebelow/kxinxu-26sep04h1600)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The index is about 1 to 1.5% below its mid-August record area, and the target is 21 trading sessions away.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-05: CNBC says the CPI report due Friday, September 11, could decide whether the Fed hikes or holds in September. It adds that no FOMC member has recently talked publicly about rate cuts, and that Trump is pushing Warsh to cut. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/05/trump-warsh-fed-september-rate-hike.html)
- 2026-09-04: August payrolls came in at about +162k against a consensus of roughly 53 to 55k. Unemployment stayed at 4.1%. Yields jumped and the S&P fell about 0.4% on worries about a Fed hike, but the index still gained for a second straight week. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/markets-news-sept-4-2026-105243532.html), [TheStreet](https://www.thestreet.com/stock-market-today/stock-market-today-dow-jones-sp-500-nasdaq-updates-sept-04-2026), [Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/09/04/the-nasdaq-sp-500-and-dow-all-fell-slightly-friday/)
- 2026-08-28: CNBC called the September Fed decision "a coin flip." CME FedWatch put the chance of a 25bp hike at about 56%, and Kalshi had it at about 48%. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/28/-september-fed-decision-now-a-coin-flip-as-rate-hike-odds-increase.html)
- 2026-08-13 and 08-14: The index set new records after soft PPI data, with an intraday peak of about 7,815 to 7,830. One secondary source reports a first close above 7,800 on Aug 14, but sources disagree on this. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-thursday-august-13-sp-500-record-high-nasdaq-dow-inflation-100145282.html), [Intellectia](https://intellectia.ai/blog/sp500-record-high-august-14-2026)
- 2026-08-07: A big miss on July jobs (-23k) pushed down the odds of a September hike. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/07/odds-the-fed-hikes-in-september-tumble-following-big-july-jobs-miss.html)
- 2026-08-04: The S&P closed at a record of about 7,737 after a four-day rally, the first record in about two months. Earnings and a drop in oil prices drove the move. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/04/investing/us-stock-market), [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2026-08-06/the-s-p-500-hit-another-record-high-in-2026-so-what-money)
- The backdrop is a Fed that is weighing hikes rather than cuts, with Warsh as chair.

## 4. Base rates
- The code's empirical 21-day distribution, starting from 7,718.60: p5 7,380, p10 7,512, p25 7,707, **p50 7,863**, p75 8,003, p90 8,134, p95 8,303.
- That implies a median move of about +1.9%. The p10 to p90 range is roughly -2.7% to +5.4%. The positive drift reflects strong returns over the past 3 years.
- September has historically been the weakest month for the S&P on average. Early October is mixed.
- The index stays well inside the question's range of 6,500 to 9,000 unless there is a drawdown of more than 15%.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi runs daily, weekly and monthly S&P above/below ladders. I could not find prices for an October 5 contract or late-September contracts.
- I found no Polymarket market for this date.
- The Kalshi year-end 2026 ladder is thinly traded; its leading bracket, "≥6,900," was priced at about 80% (date unclear). [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/odds/inxdiry)
- Strategist year-end 2026 targets are mostly below the current level:
  - A Reuters poll averaged about 7,500, and one compilation put the range at 7,100 to 8,100. [AOL/Reuters](https://www.aol.com/finance/wall-street-strategists-lift-p-170123933.html)
  - In May 2026, HSBC set 7,650 and Yardeni set 8,250. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/hsbc-yardeni-raise-sp-500-yearend-targets-on-earnings-strength-4675395)

## 6. Upcoming events before October 5
- About 2026-09-10 or 11: August CPI. Reports point to Friday, September 11, and say it could swing the hike decision. PPI is due around the same time.
- 2026-09-15 and 16: FOMC meeting, with a statement, dot plot and Warsh's press conference. Before the jobs report, the market saw roughly a 50 to 56% chance of a hike, and the hot payrolls number probably pushed that higher.
- 2026-09-18: Quarterly options and futures expiration ("triple witching") and S&P index rebalancing.
- Late September: August PCE inflation, possible risk of a government shutdown around the September 30 fiscal year-end (not verified), and the end of the quarter. Oracle and Micron earnings are typically in mid to late September.
- About 2026-10-02: September jobs report, the last major data release before resolution.
- Other risks: oil and geopolitics (oil prices were a market driver in August), rising long-term yields, and the run-up to the midterm elections.
